name: code-generator-validation-rule-evolution-3aad
instr:
validation-gen cannot compare activated API package revisions offline or explain how validation changes affect accepted values. Add deterministic JSON analysis without source generation, using generation's qualified tags, configured prefixes, type information, and validator semantics. Ordinary generation and documentation must remain unchanged.

Every registered `TagValidator`, including enum, format, each-key, each-value, custom validation, dependency, typed equality and inequality, immutable, and item-selector validators, must compare acceptance semantics through qualified-tag lookup and return a declared `Compatibility` classification, explaining unproven direction. `Analyzer` pairs occurrences only when qualified identity, scope, type path, and stable occurrence position agree; ambiguity is an error. Compare effective enum values, format extensions, nested contexts, handwritten function identities, directed sibling constraints, typed literals, operation sensitivity, and canonical selector targets, not tag spelling. Extraction, resolution, signature, and recursive comparison failures retain existing error behavior and prevent partial findings.

`Report.WriteJSON` must preserve every `Finding` field, explicitly include empty findings, and order bytes deterministically by package, location, tag, and occurrence. For deterministic validators, `VerifyCompatibility` confirms widening and narrowing against subset relationships observed through old and new generated adapters. Use
